title: collage plugin manifest
description: A collage plugin's description of itself for editors: the template functions it adds, the attributes it reads, snippets, and the schema of its section of plugins-config.json. Lives at the plugin module's root as collage.json.

name.description: The plugin's Name(): the key its configuration is found under in plugins-config.json.

description.description: What the plugin does, in a sentence.

templateFunctions.description: The template functions the plugin adds with AddTemplateFunc or AddRenderFunc.

signature.description: How it is called, as in a template: pageURL "name" ["param" value ...]

insert.description: What completion inserts, in VS Code snippet syntax. Default: the name.

attributes.description: HTML attributes the plugin reads, offered in tags.

value.description: The value completion inserts, in snippet syntax; null for a boolean attribute.

snippets.description: Snippets, by name, in VS Code's snippet format with the language they are for.

config.description: The JSON Schema of the plugin's section of plugins-config.json.
